tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour. Dark sections, cover pages, the wordmark on light grounds, the tile background.

tokens.name: ink-raised
tokens.usage: Form fields and raised panels on ink.

tokens.name: ink-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers on ink.

tokens.name: ink-border
tokens.usage: Control borders and secondary-button outlines on ink (3:1 against ink).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Default light ground for pages and documents.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Raised panels on paper; the two 'on slope' lights and the wordmark on ink.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on paper and white (15:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and labels on paper and white (6.9:1). Never lighter.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rules and card borders on paper and white.

tokens.name: text-on-ink
tokens.usage: Body text on ink.

tokens.name: text-muted-on-ink
tokens.usage: Secondary text and labels on ink (8:1).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Signal amber for use on ink only: the two amber lights, primary buttons (ink text on amber), accent rules. Never as text on paper.

tokens.name: amber-deep
tokens.usage: Amber for graphics on paper and white: the two amber lights on light grounds, chart highlight, accent rules. 3.2:1 on white, so never for text.

tokens.name: amber-text
tokens.usage: Links, eyebrow labels and emphasis text on paper and white (6.5:1).

tokens.name: amber-text-on-ink
tokens.usage: Links and eyebrow labels on ink.

tokens.name: chart-slate
tokens.usage: Third chart series after ink and amber-deep.

tokens.name: chart-sage
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series.

tokens.name: chart-stone
tokens.usage: Fifth chart series; also 'other' or comparison bars.

tokens.name: status-risk
tokens.usage: Off-track status in RAG reporting only, always paired with a label. 5.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: On-track status in RAG reporting only, always paired with a label. 6.1:1 on white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground for the current theme.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on surface.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Accent graphics (lights, rules, chart highlight) on surface. Not for text.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Accent text and links on surface.

tokens.name: light-on
tokens.usage: The two neutral lights in the logo and the status lights.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label to field, heading to sub-line.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gaps between list items.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gaps between blocks within a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gaps between a section heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a full-width page section.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and form fields.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and image placeholders.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: The logo tile only, as a share of its side.

tokens.name: radius-light
tokens.usage: The approach lights.
